decisions.reason: A water phantom for particle therapy extends the firm's core dosimetry and scanning-system expertise into a growing segment, and its release is only just occurring in 2019, so the firm can interpret early results and refine it with its in-house physicists.
Small volume ionization chambers are central to the firm's decades of dosimetry knowledge and accredited calibration capabilities, making the product easy to assimilate and improve.
A second small volume chamber variant sits squarely within the firm's core competence, though slight overlap with B adds a minor risk of portfolio consolidation.
Standard clinical ionization chambers are the firm's bread-and-butter product line, and its related knowledge strongly supports keeping and refining it.
Relative dosimetry chambers complement the firm's water phantoms and QA software, building directly on existing knowledge and integrated workflows.
Thimble chambers are a classic dosimetry device closely tied to the firm's calibration lab expertise, so it can readily learn from market feedback.
